messages.subject: Reminder: December time entries still unposted
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Our records show unposted time for December across several matters in your group. Please ensure all narratives are entered and released by Friday 23 January so we can run the January bills. If you have any write-offs to flag, let me know.

Regards,
Accounts
